title: Moonchase Fox
summary: A palm-sized sleeping fox whose curled tail becomes a gentle rocking track, circling a real crescent window before settling upright.
interaction: Nudge the fox lightly from either side and let the tail arc carry a short chase before gravity returns the crescent upright.
materials: Rigid FDM filament such as PLA or PETG
limitations: Digital checks do not prove real rocking duration, surface friction, durability, or print quality.
Use on a level, hard desk away from edges; this is not intended for young children.
